repository_scope.object: finite deterministic mathematical models, exact certificates, lower bounds, witnesses, and no-go results
allowed: declared grammars and controlled transition systems
formal ecological interpretation of model variables after theorem scope is stated
deterministic replay artifacts and regression tests
prohibited: parameter fitting or statistical estimation from observations
claims that a passing certificate validates an observed ecosystem
repository_scope.interpretation_boundary: Ecological mechanisms may motivate a declared state space or grammar in a separate application layer. This repository verifies only the stated finite mathematical object.

entries.title: Finite closure classification
entries.domain: A declared finite total deterministic update map.
entries.assumptions: The state set and transition map are finite and total.
entries.conclusion: The certificate classifies the map as globally closing, recurrent, or multistable.
entries.non_claim: Local ecological rules alone identify one long-run endpoint or establish portability.
entries.ecological_role: Abstract prerequisite for deciding whether a declared finite model itself closes; it is not an empirical stability analysis.

entries.title: Exact grammar-aware dynamic interface
entries.domain: A finite deterministic controlled system together with a fixed finite legal-action grammar.
entries.assumptions: The system, outputs, actions, and grammar are explicitly declared and finite.
entries.conclusion: The legal-word quotient is the coarsest exact interface preserving output, legal actions, and legal successors.
entries.non_claim: The supplied finite grammar is automatically the correct ecological boundary contract.
entries.ecological_role: Formal object for a proposed ecological boundary summary after the permissible interventions and exterior actions are declared.

entries.title: Addressable-completion lower bound and extension--compression noncommutation
entries.domain: A declared jointly realizable product subsystem with explicit legal decoder words.
entries.assumptions: Inside and exterior coordinates are independently future-addressable under the supplied grammar; fixed contexts admit the stated closed factorization.
entries.conclusion: Exact open interface memory is at least the logarithm of the addressable product size, yielding the extension--compression gap under closed-context factorization.
entries.non_claim: Exterior memory adds in every composition without joint realization and operational separation.
entries.ecological_role: Formalizes when independently controllable outside processes force a larger exact summary; it does not estimate those processes from field data.

entries.title: Binary relay sharpness realization
entries.domain: The declared binary relay family and its bounded-degree compilation.
entries.assumptions: The relay topology, local grammar, and pairwise protocol are the supplied finite construction.
entries.conclusion: The construction attains the stated binary equality case with constant local grammar, pairwise messages, and degree at most three.
entries.non_claim: Bounded degree by itself forces interface inflation in arbitrary systems.
entries.ecological_role: A locality-respecting mathematical witness, not a claim that ecological interaction networks implement this relay construction.

entries.title: Nested composition portability ladder
entries.domain: Finite nested controlled systems linked by declared embeddings and, where needed, monotone legal-action growth.
entries.assumptions: Common macro dynamics, label-coherent embeddings, and for action growth fixed old meanings plus label-deterministic new actions.
entries.conclusion: The certificates distinguish bounded summary size, one shared exact macro-law, and one conservative schema on an expanded union grammar.
entries.non_claim: These sufficient conditions are necessary for every portable macro-law.
entries.ecological_role: Formalizes controlled growth of a declared composition grammar; no ecological assembly process is inferred.

entries.title: Future-word and new-action fiber-split obstructions
entries.domain: A finite proposed macro fiber and a declared later legal word or newly legal action.
entries.assumptions: The supplied word or action is legal in the relevant later grammar and yields distinct output traces or successor labels from two states in one proposed fiber.
entries.non_claim: One split rules out every alternative macro-law or proves a global memory lower bound.
entries.ecological_role: A formal warning that a newly permitted intervention can invalidate one coarse ecological state description.

entries.title: Non-nested edge preservation with supplied projections
entries.domain: A connected declared finite replacement graph of grammar-aware controlled systems.
entries.assumptions: Each stage already realizes the same exact macro dynamics; every edge relation is total, label/output/legal-action preserving, and successor-closed.
entries.conclusion: One exact macro-law is shared across the declared replacement family, even for many-to-one or one-to-many relations.
entries.non_claim: A target projection can always be constructed without target-fiber consistency.
entries.ecological_role: Abstract replacement or rewiring under a declared transition relation; it is not an inferred ecological turnover process.

entries.title: Transported target exact factorization
entries.domain: One exact finite source projection, one finite target system, and a total declared relation.
entries.assumptions: Target-fiber label consistency, output preservation, equal legal-action rows, and successor closure.
entries.conclusion: The derived target labels form an exact grammar-aware projection and induce the source macro dynamics.
entries.non_claim: This is a necessary classification of replacement portability or a theorem for target-only actions.
entries.ecological_role: Formal transport of a boundary summary across a declared non-nested replacement, not a fitted ecological coarse-graining.

entries.title: Conservative non-nested transport with target-only actions
entries.domain: One exact finite source projection, one finite target system with possible target-only actions, and a total declared relation.
entries.assumptions: Old source-legal actions remain legal and successor-closed; target fibers are label-consistent and output-preserving; each target-only action has uniform availability and macro successor within each derived target fiber.
entries.conclusion: The certificate derives a target projection and one conservative macro schema whose source rows are restrictions and target rows are expanded realizations.
entries.non_claim: All newly legal actions are portable; nonuniform availability or successor labels may split the proposed fiber.
entries.ecological_role: Formalizes a controlled expansion of permitted ecological interactions only after their macro-level action semantics are declared uniform.

entries.title: Non-nested newly-legal-word split
entries.domain: A declared replacement relation carrying a proposed source merge into a target where a previously illegal word becomes legal.
entries.assumptions: The new legal word separates two carried states in one proposed target fiber.
entries.conclusion: The proposed carried merge is refuted.
entries.non_claim: The obstruction proves unbounded memory or rules out every alternative macro-law.
entries.ecological_role: A declared new interaction can falsify one carried ecological state summary; this is not evidence that all coarse descriptions fail.

entries.title: Delayed exposure and adaptive finite-evidence no-go
entries.domain: A declared family of delay-gated finite systems and finite-depth adaptive observation policies.
entries.assumptions: The policy depth is finite and the completion family admits a delayed separating exposure beyond its transcript horizon.
entries.conclusion: Finite transcript-only evidence cannot uniformly certify closure over that family without an independent horizon and grammar contract.
entries.non_claim: No finite experiment can certify closure once a finite horizon and completion contract are independently supplied.
entries.ecological_role: Formalizes why finite monitoring alone cannot establish ecological closure under an unrestricted future-context class.

entries.title: Candidate-universal macro-law criterion
entries.domain: A finite retained family of candidate mechanisms and declared actions.
entries.assumptions: Each candidate induces a finite macro action map on the stated macro space.
entries.conclusion: A deterministic candidate-universal macro law exists exactly when all candidate-induced maps agree for every declared action.
entries.non_claim: Candidate uncertainty and composition growth are the same theoretical axis.
entries.ecological_role: Separates mechanism ambiguity from open-boundary growth in a finite abstract model; it does not select ecological mechanisms from data.

entries.title: Joint exterior--mechanism lower bound
entries.domain: A declared finite joint exterior and candidate-mechanism realization with explicit separation.
entries.assumptions: The joint product and distinguishing action words are supplied, not inferred.
entries.conclusion: The stated joint separation forces the corresponding interface-memory lower bound.
entries.non_claim: Separate exterior and candidate lower bounds automatically add without a joint realization premise.
entries.ecological_role: A formal joint uncertainty bound; it is not a quantitative estimate for ecological latent variables.

entries.title: Frozen conditional experimental-design results
entries.domain: Finite protocols after a quotient, reset, coverage, and failure contract have already been fixed.
entries.assumptions: The structural interface and operational protocol contracts are supplied before design optimization or robustness analysis.
entries.conclusion: The shelf provides executable conditional design, coverage, robustness, and failure-domain results.
certificates: legacy shelf only; no new public theorem work
verification: python -m pytest tests/test_delayed_joint_reset_panels.py tests/test_witnessed_boundary_evidence.py tests/test_robust_canonical_panels.py tests/test_observation_regime_closure.py -q
entries.non_claim: These design results establish closure or portability by themselves.
entries.ecological_role: Potential protocol mathematics after a finite model contract is fixed; no field protocol or empirical study is represented here.
